topic.title: Company Name
topic.shortdesc: This library includes Company name variables. Each label variable is defined in a separate paragraph by means of the <ph> element. The <ph> attribute 'varid' should hold a unique name for the variable.

body.p: For referring to the brand Acadian
For first instance in a deliverable Acadian, Incorporated
For all other instances in a deliverable Acadian, Inc.
For legal use when all caps ACADIAN
